name: Siansa Analysis
author: Siansa
description: For the Siansa app: measures each song's loudness and how it starts and ends (levelling and SmoothFade), and finds similar albums and artists from AudioMuse-AI's sound analysis.

versions.changelog: Similar albums and artists now work for every music server in AudioMuse (for example Emby next to Navidrome): the server the app names is looked up the way AudioMuse does it, and only albums and artists on that server are listed.
Works with several music servers: loudness profiles and similar albums and artists follow the server the app names (for example an Emby server next to Navidrome).
Siansa Analysis: volume and fade profiles for levelling and SmoothFade, and similar albums and artists from AudioMuse-AI's sound analysis.
